2026-10-31.notes: Final day of Season Twelve — no programming, just the close-out: "It's Been a Blast!! 335 Days until Season 13. See you then!!" Per the caption, the book closes until next year when we write a new chapter. When in doubt, SQUAT it out! — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-29.focus: Squatober Day 29 — One last GET RIGHT
2026-10-29.notes: Warm up: make your playlist, strategize your max warm up routine, remind your friends to attend. One last Tune Up before the Friday Showdown — even though the weight is lighter, move with maximum speed and intent. 90 sec rest between all sets on every movement. Cardio is a planned day off. This should be the shortest lifting session yet; the goal is to have your batteries charged up fully for Friday. Recovery: Sloppy Joes & Tator Tots (fix them extra sloppy), 15 min walk, sleep for the Big One. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-28.focus: Squatober Day 28 — The Day before THE DAY BEFORE
2026-10-28.notes: Warm up as a superset: KB swings and bodyweight Bulgarians, just your bodyweight, 2 min rest between sets. 90 sec rest between each Speedy Single — give the same effort on these lighter singles as you did on Monday's heavy singles, and learn to MOVE DAT WEIGHT with intent. 2 1/2 min rest between bench press sets. Keep the BB RDLs at medium intensity with 2 min rest; 90 sec rest between pushup sets. Get in, get the stimulus, get out — should take 30 to 35 minutes. Recovery: chicken & dumplings, 30 min walk, sleep for success. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-25.notes: Rest day. Get some rest so everyone is ready for a great final push — basic strength training Monday through Thursday next week sets you up for Friday success. Recovery meals for Week 5 are on the post's second slide. When in doubt, SQUAT it out! — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-17.notes: Rest day. Dig down deep and rely on your discipline. Take care of yourself over the weekend and do the things needed so we can start Monday extremely strong. 2026-10-14.notes: Warm up: loosen up the lats and low back, then 3 sets of 3-5 reps for chin ups, rest as needed. 2 1/2 min rest between sets on the back squat, bench press and Bulgarians; rest as needed on the pushups. Keep the Bulgarians mild/medium intensity — they will sneak up on you. Close grip pushups with thumbs about 8" apart. Video example of the Double Bottom Bounce is on the post's second slide. Recovery: Hamburger Helper, 30 min walk, sleep to grow thick. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-02.focus: Squatober Day 2 — Bending in a Polo
2026-10-02.notes: Back squat at 62% — belt off, all 32 reps identical with depth that leaves no doubt. 2 min rest between sets; 90 sec between Zercher sets, 60 sec between carries. Warm up: 5 jumping jacks + 5 pushups, repeat as needed. Recovery: extra meaty pot roast, 30 min walk, 8+ hrs sleep. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-04.notes: Rest day. Resting, walking and eating are high priority — there are still some things to actively do to stay on track with the plan. 5 days of strength training is on deck for week 2. Be ready. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-05.focus: Squatober Day 5 — Never Miss a Monday
2026-10-05.notes: 2 min rest between back squat sets; 2 1/2 min between bench sets; 2 min between row/lateral-raise superset rounds; 60 sec between warm-up carries and cardio sets. Increase weight each carry set. Bench burnout set at 85% — if you get 4 or less reps, lower your bench max 5%; 8 or more reps, raise it 3%. Slow the tempo on the pushups to make them more challenging. Recovery: sloppy joes and tator tots, 30 min walk, deep heavy sleep. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-08.notes: 2 1/2 min rest between back squat sets; 2 1/2 min between bench sets; 2 min between chin up sets; 60 sec between KB swing sets. Warm up: bounce around and get the mind, body, and spirit on High Alert. Use the same training max you've used the last seven days. Goal is to hit the 100% rep — if you can't, lower your training max. Bonus attempts at 102.5% and 105% only if you're 100% confident you will succeed. No misses, and hold yourself accountable to great depth. If a bonus attempt is good, make that your new training max. Recovery: lasagna (get an extra helping), 30 min walk, sleep deep and heavy. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-09.notes: Tempo squats: 5 sec tempo down, regular tempo up — hold yourself accountable to a realistic five second count, no fast counting. 3 min rest between squat sets; 90 sec between overhead press sets; 90 sec between close grip bench / rear lateral raise superset rounds; 2 min between triceps pushdown / bicep 21s superset rounds; 90 sec between pinch hold sets. Pay attention to the rest times and put weight on the bar — the rest of the program is going to initiate a massive pump. Warm up: pick out the perfect Polo to get absolutely jacked in. Recovery: smash burgers & fries, 30 min walk, sleep to grow. — via @sorinex_squatober

2026-10-11.notes: Rest day. Everyone has been training hard all week so please enjoy some downtime to get ready for a new week. Week three will be more basic strength training. Recovery meals are on slide two for next week. — via @sorinex_squatober

exercises.name: Map out ways to get extra sleep

2026-10-13.notes: Warm up: DB or KB farmer's carry, 4 x 30 yds, increase weight each set, 90 sec rest between sets. 3 sec pause in the deep bottom of the back squat — hold yourself accountable to a full three second count; having a training partner count the seconds helps. Medium intensity on the Zerchers, 2 min rest between sets. Waiter/suitcase carry: walk 20 yds, switch arm positions, walk 20 more yds — that completes one set of 40 yds; 90 sec rest between sets. Elevating your heels for the squat thrusters is fine. 60 sec rest between KB swing sets. Video examples on slides two and three. Recovery: eggs, bacon, biscuits & gravy, 30 min walk, sleep to grow strong. — via @sorinex_squatober
